description: BEAVRS, published by MIT Computational Reactor Physics Group and contributing plant operators, provides a detailed benchmark of a four-loop Westinghouse reactor and its first two operating cycles. Coverage: A four-loop Westinghouse plant, including the first two operating cycles, assembly loadings, absorber layouts, histories, rod positions, boron concentrations and detector readings. The linked provider page supplies documentation and the access route; no resource files were downloaded. The licence is Not stated in the pages reviewed; reuse permission is uncertain. Price and access terms require confirmation unless explicitly stated above. Limitations: The public description does not establish exact detector-file formats, a reuse licence or independent completeness checks. The benchmark covers two cycles, not all operating conditions. For catalogue screening, its documented functions support capacity planning, resilience studies; this is an assessment of possible use, not a claim of validated performance.
